body:
**Original comment by Leopoldo Saggin (Bitbucket: [Leopoldo Saggin](https://bitbucket.org/Leopoldo Saggin), ).**

----------------------------------------

I tried to repeat what I have done in another PC with Windows 11 at the same patch level using ART 1.23 also in this case.  
Besides, in this 2nd PC I copied exactly the same content of:  
\%USERNAME%\\%APPDATA%\\ART  
I had in the first one.  
In this case the “Windows security” against ransomware was not set to “protected access” to directories for ART and the image processed was the same I used before. In this case I had no problem in starting my queue and getting the output.  

Maybe another point I didn’t mention before that could be important: in both experiments I set as output directory a dir I created by myself and which was a subdir of the dir where I saved images to be processed.  
BUT, while in the first case before doing this, I tried to create a queue chosing the default method which is:  
“Use template” %p1/converted/%f  
in the 2nd experiment  I chosed directly the:  
”Save to folder” method.  
In the first experiment in fact the prg told me that that dir was not found, probably because ART was not allowed to create dirs due to Windows security settings. 

Regards,  
Topoldo/Leopoldo
